name: Pawnshop Smash-and-Grab
briefing: Regina's tip sounds too small for the hour: a pawnshop in Kabuki, one nervous clerk, one locked case, one data shard hidden inside a dead rockerboy's guitar pickup. She will not say who wants it, only that two other crews asked and both stopped answering.
stakes: This is the kind of little job that buys food, ammo, and one more week of pretending the crew is not already circling something much bigger.
complication: The shop is a shrine to old Night City ghosts. Crack the wrong case and every cheap relic in the room starts screaming on the local mesh.

obstacles.name: Keep the clerk talking while their panic alarm blinks red under the counter
Crack the display case without waking the pawnshop's bargain-bin defense grid
